integrity: All assertions concern the time-dependent Padé end-step and are supported by the supplied algebraic proof; a reproducible exact-rational checker gives additional finite-case evidence, not a general proof. Earlier static M-property priority is explicitly attributed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform edge weights; connected noncomplete strongly regular graphs; conservative undirected Laplacian; endpoint [2/2] Padé only. The equivalent static M-property threshold, complement duality and graph-family boundaries predate this dynamic result. An independent expert assessment has not been performed.
title: Exact positivity intervals for fourth-order Padé diffusion on strongly regular graphs
